Days before Trump’s second inauguration, the United Arab Emirates’ “Spy Sheikh” secretly bought 49% of the Trump family’s crypto firm. Months later, the administration handed over America’s most sensitive AI chips technology to the UAE despite national security concerns. 

This isn’t just profiteering—it’s a betrayal of U.S. national security. ampr.gs/42uGykJ

Late last Friday, the Hawaii State Legislature approved a historic measure that would effectively undo the corrosive effects of the Supreme Court’s Citizens United decision.
